iOS Sounds • iOS Emojis • SF Pro Display Font • Multi-Root Support

## 🔍 Overview **Sound_And_Emoji_IOS** is a comprehensive Android root module that systemlessly replaces: 1. **All system sounds** (UI, ringtones, notifications, alarms) with authentic iOS audio 2. **System-wide emojis** with the latest iOS emoji font (including OEM-specific replacements) 3. **System typography** with Apple's **SF Pro Display** font family The module uses an intelligent multi-stage boot pipeline to ensure 100% persistence across reboots, ROM updates, and aggressive Google Play Services font re-downloads. --- ## ✨ Features | Feature | Description | | :--- | :--- | | 🔊 The installer will warn you if none is detected. ### Xiaomi HyperOS 3/4 — Special Requirements Xiaomi HyperOS implements a proprietary **MiFontOverlay** service that forcefully overrides system fonts at the Zygote level, ignoring any file-level replacements. To make **iOS emojis** work on HyperOS devices, you need an additional module: | Requirement | Details | | :--- | :--- | | **DisableMiFontOverlay** | [YuKongA/DisableMiFontOverlay](https://github.com/YuKongA/DisableMiFontOverlay) — Zygisk module that disables Xiaomi's font override | | **Zygisk / ZygiskNext** | Required for DisableMiFontOverlay to function | | **Metamodule** (KSU/APatch) | `meta-overlayfsx`, `meta-overlayfs`, `Hybrid Mount`, or `NanoMount` | > [!NOTE] > **Sounds and SF Pro font work normally** on HyperOS without any extra modules. The module installer will **automatically detect** HyperOS and warn you if DisableMiFontOverlay is missing. ### gbl_root_canoe (Fake Locked Bootloader) For devices rooted via **gbl_root_canoe** (Snapdragon 8 Gen5 / 8 Elite with fake locked bootloader): | Requirement | Details | | :--- | :--- | | **Metamodule** | **Required** — `meta-overlayfsx`, `meta-overlayfs`, or `Hybrid Mount` (OverlayFS must mount module files) | | **Kernel OverlayFS** | Kernel must have `CONFIG_OVERLAY_FS=y` (check: `cat /proc/filesystems \| grep overlay`) | | **DisableMiFontOverlay** | Required for emoji on HyperOS (same as above) | The installer automatically detects gbl_root_canoe environments and provides specific warnings. Note that KernelSU Next naturally preserves `verifiedbootstate=green` without breaking verified boot; the module distinguishes this cleanly from canoe to prevent false alarms. --- ## 🚀 Installation 1. Download the latest `Sound_And_Emoji_IOS.zip` from [Releases](https://github.com/antoniomalheirs/Sound_And_Emoji_IOS/releases) 2. Open your root manager (**Magisk Manager**, **KernelSU Manager**, or **APatch**) 3. Flash the `.zip` via the **Modules** → **Install from storage** option 4. **Reboot** your device 5. Enjoy the iOS experience! 🎉 > [!NOTE] > The module clears the Gboard emoji cache during installation. You may notice a brief delay on the first keyboard launch after reboot while Gboard rebuilds its emoji index. --- ## 🏗️ Architecture & Boot Lifecycle The module uses a sophisticated multi-stage boot pipeline to ensure everything works across all root solutions and Android versions: ```mermaid graph TD subgraph INSTALL["📥 Installation (customize.sh)"] I1[Detect Root Environment] --> I2[4-Layer ROM Identification] I2 --> I3[Dynamic Metamodule Discovery] I3 --> I4[Mirror Audio Across Partitions] I4 --> I5[Map OEM & Flag Fonts] I5 --> I6[Clean Gboard & EmojiCompat Caches] I6 --> I7[Apply SELinux Contexts & Permissions] end subgraph BOOT1["🔒 post-fs-data.sh (Pre-Mount)"] B1["Nuke font caches & locks:

**Root Detection:** Identifies Magisk, KernelSU, KernelSU Next, or APatch - **Dynamic Metamodule Discovery:** Scans running metamodules dynamically (`meta-overlayfsx` / OverlayFS Enhanced, `meta-hybrid_mount`, `NanoMount`, `meta-overlayfs`) instead of relying on hardcoded paths - **4-Layer Deep ROM Identification:** Accurately identifies custom ROMs (crDroid, LineageOS, Axion OS, Evolution X, PixelOS, etc.) across 4 layers: property service, direct filesystem `build.prop` inspection, priv-app control hubs, and package manager (`pm list packages`) - **Hardware vs ROM Skin Separation:** On custom ROMs running on Xiaomi, POCO, Redmi, Samsung, or OPPO hardware, the installer provides full OEM font and audio compatibility mappings without false HyperOS or OneUI labeling - **API-Based Path Selection:** Uses `/system/product/` for Android 12+ or mirrors to `/system/media/` for Android 11 - **OEM Emoji Detection:** Scans `/system/fonts/` for manufacturer-specific emoji fonts and creates replacements only for fonts that actually exist - **Surgical Gboard Emoji DB Reset:** Purges `bundled_emoji_provider.db`, layout textures, and emoji superpacks across all profiles without `pm clear`, preserving user dictionary, custom layouts, microphone permissions, and offline Faster Voice Typing models - **Global EmojiCompat Sweep:** Scans installed apps during installation to purge cached stock emoji fonts (`files/fonts/`), forcing apps to use system iOS emojis - **OverlayFS Integration:** Detects and supports `magisk_overlayfs` for restricted partitions - **SELinux Enforcement:** Applies `u:object_r:system_file:s0` context to all installed files ### `post-fs-data.sh` — Pre-Mount Cache Nuker Runs BEFORE the module is mounted. Has a strict 10-second timeout. - Deletes `/data/fonts/` (system font updates) - Cleans GMS font provider caches - Clears Gboard emoji caches, databases, and early-boot EmojiCompat caches (`files/fonts/`, `no_backup/*emoji*`, `files/emoji_metadata*`) - Removes Messenger font download directories ### `post-mount.sh` — SELinux Context Enforcer (KSU/APatch) Runs AFTER module files are mounted (pre-boot stage). - **Lightning-Fast SELinux Relabeling:** Uses fast recursive `chcon -R u:object_r:system_file:s0` across module partitions (`/system`, `/product`, `/system_ext`), slashing pre-boot staging time from ~4000ms down to ~15ms while keeping early boot 100% safe against timeout bootloops - **Rotated Stage Logging:** Logs execution status to `$MODDIR/post-mount.log` with automatic log rotation (>100KB rollover) ### `service.sh` — Late Start Service (Universal) The main runtime script. Waits for `sys.boot_completed=1` before executing. - **resetprop:** Force-sets 25+ `ro.config.*` sound properties that Android 14+ may overwrite during boot - **OxygenOS / ColorOS Camera Protection:** Dynamically checks OEM properties (`ro.oplus.image.my_manifest`, `ro.product.manufacturer`, `ro.product.brand`) to skip camera sound `resetprop` on OPPO, OnePlus, and Realme devices, preventing native camera validation crashes while keeping all iOS UI sounds active - **Global emoji replacement:** Scans ALL app directories for emoji font files and replaces them - **Global EmojiCompat / emoji2 Cache Cleaner:** Scans all user apps (`/data/data` and `/data/user/`) for `androidx.emoji2` / `EmojiCompat` downloaded stock fonts in `files/fonts/`, forcing apps like Snapchat and Google Messages to render system iOS emojis - **Universal Meta Emoji Deployment:** Deploys iOS emoji directly to Facebook, Messenger, and Lite variants in `app_ras_blobs/FacebookEmoji.ttf` with legitimate user ownership (`chmod 644`), while skipping Instagram to protect Story reply stability - **GMS Font Provider Deactivation:** Disables `FontsProvider` and `UpdateSchedulerService` in Google Play Services across all user profiles to prevent stock emoji font re-downloads or Google metadata injection - **Boot-time Gboard Emoji Cache Purge:** Clears Gboard layout, expression, and emoji superpacks (`files/superpacks/emoji*`) during boot so the keyboard re-indexes the system iOS font while keeping offline voice recognition models intact - **Automated Diagnostic Bundle:** Consolidates an Executive Health Summary, partition layout, overlay mount audit, font comparison table, technical ROM identification audit, and stage logs into `diagnostic_report.log`, auto-exported to `/sdcard/Download/Sound_And_Emoji_IOS_diagnostic.log` - **AOSP-Guarded Checks:** Guards HyperOS checks (`MiFontOverlay`) so AOSP ROMs correctly report `N/A (AOSP / Not HyperOS — not required)` without false warnings - **Media Scanner (Magisk):** Broadcasts `MEDIA_SCANNER_SCAN_FILE` intents for all audio files so they appear in Android's sound picker ### `dump_logs.sh` — On-Demand Diagnostic Tool Standalone root utility script included in the module root. - Can be executed anytime from Termux or ADB (`su -c sh /data/adb/modules/Sound_And_Emoji_IOS/dump_logs.sh`) - Re-runs the full diagnostic inspection suite on demand - Saves internal log to `/data/adb/modules/Sound_And_Emoji_IOS/diagnostic_report.log` and automatically exports to `/sdcard/Download/Sound_And_Emoji_IOS_diagnostic.log` for easy sharing ### `boot-completed.sh` — Post-Boot Hook (KSU/APatch) KernelSU and APatch support this hook natively. Provides a clean way to re-apply properties after the system is fully booted. - Re-applies all `ro.config.*` sound properties via `resetprop` (with OEM camera exclusions for OPPO, OnePlus, and Realme devices) - Triggers media scanner for ringtones, notifications, and alarms ### `sepolicy.rule` — SELinux Policy Custom SEPolicy rules that allow: - `mediaserver` and `audioserver` to read module-mounted audio files - Untrusted apps (Facebook/Messenger) to read bind-mounted emoji fonts - Platform apps (Gboard) and GMS to read system emoji fonts ### `system.prop` — System Properties Declares default ringtone, notification, and alarm properties. Kept for backwards compatibility with older Android versions where `system.prop` is reliably applied during boot. ### `uninstall.sh` — Clean Removal Removes the module directory from `/data/adb/modules/` on uninstallation. --- ## 📂 Project Structure ``` Sound_And_Emoji_IOS/ ├── META-INF/ # Flashable ZIP metadata │ └── com/google/android/ │ ├── update-binary # Magisk module installer │ └── updater-script # Required (empty marker) │ ├── system/ │ ├── fonts/ # Font replacements │ │ ├── NotoColorEmoji.ttf # iOS emoji font (system-wide) │ │ ├── SF-Pro-Display-Regular.ttf │ │ ├── SF-Pro-Display-Bold.ttf │ │ ├── SF-Pro-Display-Medium.ttf │ │ ├── SF-Pro-Display-Semibold.ttf │ │ ├── SF-Pro-Display-Light.ttf │ │ ├── SF-Pro-Display-Thin.ttf │ │ ├── SF-Pro-Display-Heavy.ttf │ │ ├── SF-Pro-Display-Ultralight.ttf │ │ └── ... Instead, WhatsApp bundles its own proprietary emoji set directly inside the APK to maintain visual consistency across Android, iOS, and Web platforms. This is a deliberate architectural decision by Meta. **What this means:** - ✅ System UI, Gboard, SMS, Chrome, and most apps → **iOS emojis work perfectly** - ✅ Facebook, Instagram, Messenger → **iOS emojis work** (replaced via module) - ❌ WhatsApp → **uses its own emojis** (cannot be changed without modifying the APK) > [!NOTE] > This is **not a bug in the module** — it is a WhatsApp limitation. The only way to change WhatsApp's emojis would be to use a modified APK (which violates WhatsApp's Terms of Service and may result in account suspension). ### Telegram Telegram has its own emoji rendering system that can be configured in-app. Check **Settings → Chat Settings → Emoji** to use system emojis. --- ## 🔄 OTA Updates The module supports in-app updates via the `updateJson` mechanism. Your root manager will automatically check for new versions. **Update URL:** `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/antoniomalheirs/Sound_And_Emoji_IOS/main/update_metada/update.json` --- ## 🔧 Troubleshooting ### 📊 Diagnostic Report (Attach to GitHub Issues) The module automatically generates a comprehensive diagnostic report on every boot: - **Saved on device (Zero-Root Export):** `/sdcard/Download/Sound_And_Emoji_IOS_diagnostic.log` (also at `/sdcard/Sound_And_Emoji_IOS_diagnostic.log`) - **Internal module report (Root / Termux):** `/data/adb/modules/Sound_And_Emoji_IOS/diagnostic_report.log` - **Zero-root access required:** You can find the exported file directly inside your phone's default **Files** or **Downloads** app without needing root explorers! - **Attach to Issues:** If you experience any issues, simply open a new issue on GitHub and attach this file. It contains the complete status of partitions, metamodules, font sizes, audio paths, Gboard cache, technical ROM identification audits, and boot stage logs. - **Technical ROM Audit:** Includes section `[1b. ROM IDENTIFICATION AUDIT]` detailing raw queried properties, matched `build.prop` entries, custom ROM packages, and priv-app directories. - **Dedicated Stage Logs:** Each lifecycle stage preserves its own log file inside `/data/adb/modules/Sound_And_Emoji_IOS/`: - `install.log` — Installer actions, partition choices, and OEM mappings - `post-fs-data.log` — Pre-mount cache clearing and font directory immutable locks - `post-mount.log` — Recursive SELinux context relabeling - `service.log` — Runtime properties, app emoji deployments, and daemon status - `boot-completed.log` — Post-boot property enforcement To generate a fresh diagnostic report on demand from a root terminal (Termux / ADB): ```sh su -c sh /data/adb/modules/Sound_And_Emoji_IOS/dump_logs.sh ``` ---

  • **System-wide emojis** with the latest iOS emoji font (including OEM-specific replacements)
  • **System typography** with Apple's **SF Pro Display** font family

    | 🔊 Complete iOS Sound Set | 43 audio files covering UI, ringtones, notifications, alarms, camera, NFC, charging, and more |

    `customize.sh` — Installation Engine

    The installation script adapts to the device environment:

  • **Root Detection:** Identifies Magisk, KernelSU, KernelSU Next, or APatch
  • **Dynamic Metamodule Discovery:** Scans running metamodules dynamically (`meta-overlayfsx` / OverlayFS Enhanced, `meta-hybrid_mount`, `NanoMount`, `meta-overlayfs`) instead of relying on hardcoded paths
  • **4-Layer Deep ROM Identification:** Accurately identifies custom ROMs (crDroid, LineageOS, Axion OS, Evolution X, PixelOS, etc.) across 4 layers: property service, direct filesystem `build.prop` inspection, priv-app control hubs, and package manager (`pm list packages`)
  • **Hardware vs ROM Skin Separation:** On custom ROMs running on Xiaomi, POCO, Redmi, Samsung, or OPPO hardware, the installer provides full OEM font and audio compatibility mappings without false HyperOS or OneUI labeling
  • **API-Based Path Selection:** Uses `/system/product/` for Android 12+ or mirrors to `/system/media/` for Android 11
  • **OEM Emoji Detection:** Scans `/system/fonts/` for manufacturer-specific emoji fonts and creates replacements only for fonts that actually exist
  • **Surgical Gboard Emoji DB Reset:** Purges `bundled_emoji_provider.db`, layout textures, and emoji superpacks across all profiles without `pm clear`, preserving user dictionary, custom layouts, microphone permissions, and offline Faster Voice Typing models
  • **Global EmojiCompat Sweep:** Scans installed apps during installation to purge cached stock emoji fonts (`files/fonts/`), forcing apps to use system iOS emojis
  • **OverlayFS Integration:** Detects and supports `magisk_overlayfs` for restricted partitions
  • **SELinux Enforcement:** Applies `u:object_r:system_file:s0` context to all installed files

    • `post-fs-data.sh` — Pre-Mount Cache Nuker

    Runs BEFORE the module is mounted. Has a strict 10-second timeout.

  • Deletes `/data/fonts/` (system font updates)
  • Cleans GMS font provider caches
  • Clears Gboard emoji caches, databases, and early-boot EmojiCompat caches (`files/fonts/`, `no_backup/*emoji*`, `files/emoji_metadata*`)
  • Removes Messenger font download directories

    • `post-mount.sh` — SELinux Context Enforcer (KSU/APatch)

    Runs AFTER module files are mounted (pre-boot stage).

  • **Lightning-Fast SELinux Relabeling:** Uses fast recursive `chcon -R u:object_r:system_file:s0` across module partitions (`/system`, `/product`, `/system_ext`), slashing pre-boot staging time from ~4000ms down to ~15ms while keeping early boot 100% safe against timeout bootloops
  • **Rotated Stage Logging:** Logs execution status to `$MODDIR/post-mount.log` with automatic log rotation (>100KB rollover)

    • `service.sh` — Late Start Service (Universal)

    The main runtime script. Waits for sys.boot_completed=1 before executing.

  • **resetprop:** Force-sets 25+ `ro.config.*` sound properties that Android 14+ may overwrite during boot
  • **OxygenOS / ColorOS Camera Protection:** Dynamically checks OEM properties (`ro.oplus.image.my_manifest`, `ro.product.manufacturer`, `ro.product.brand`) to skip camera sound `resetprop` on OPPO, OnePlus, and Realme devices, preventing native camera validation crashes while keeping all iOS UI sounds active
  • **Global emoji replacement:** Scans ALL app directories for emoji font files and replaces them
  • **Global EmojiCompat / emoji2 Cache Cleaner:** Scans all user apps (`/data/data` and `/data/user/`) for `androidx.emoji2` / `EmojiCompat` downloaded stock fonts in `files/fonts/`, forcing apps like Snapchat and Google Messages to render system iOS emojis
  • **Universal Meta Emoji Deployment:** Deploys iOS emoji directly to Facebook, Messenger, and Lite variants in `app_ras_blobs/FacebookEmoji.ttf` with legitimate user ownership (`chmod 644`), while skipping Instagram to protect Story reply stability
  • **GMS Font Provider Deactivation:** Disables `FontsProvider` and `UpdateSchedulerService` in Google Play Services across all user profiles to prevent stock emoji font re-downloads or Google metadata injection
  • **Boot-time Gboard Emoji Cache Purge:** Clears Gboard layout, expression, and emoji superpacks (`files/superpacks/emoji*`) during boot so the keyboard re-indexes the system iOS font while keeping offline voice recognition models intact
  • **Automated Diagnostic Bundle:** Consolidates an Executive Health Summary, partition layout, overlay mount audit, font comparison table, technical ROM identification audit, and stage logs into `diagnostic_report.log`, auto-exported to `/sdcard/Download/Sound_And_Emoji_IOS_diagnostic.log`
  • **AOSP-Guarded Checks:** Guards HyperOS checks (`MiFontOverlay`) so AOSP ROMs correctly report `N/A (AOSP / Not HyperOS — not required)` without false warnings
  • **Media Scanner (Magisk):** Broadcasts `MEDIA_SCANNER_SCAN_FILE` intents for all audio files so they appear in Android's sound picker

    Snapchat or Gboard emoji panel still showing stock Google emojis (Issue #12)

  • Apps using `androidx.emoji2` or `EmojiCompat` (such as Snapchat and Gboard's emoji keyboard drawer) can dynamically download stock Google emoji fonts into their internal `files/fonts/` cache or `no_backup/` directory, overriding system fonts.

  • Reboot the device

  • Run the diagnostic tool to check status: `su -c sh /data/adb/modules/Sound_And_Emoji_IOS/dump_logs.sh`
  • Look for `MiFontOverlay` and `fonts_custom.xml` lines in the report

    • > Note: Sounds and SF Pro font work normally without DisableMiFontOverlay. Only emoji replacement requires it. On AOSP custom ROMs (such as crDroid, Axion OS, LineageOS) running on Xiaomi hardware, MiFontOverlay is not present and DisableMiFontOverlay is not required.

    Devices rooted via gbl_root_canoe (fake locked bootloader) have extra requirements:

  • **Install a metamodule** — `meta-overlayfsx` (OverlayFS Enhanced), `meta-hybrid_mount`, `meta-overlayfs`, or `NanoMount` is required for OverlayFS to work
  • **Check kernel OverlayFS support:** `su -c "cat /proc/filesystems | grep overlay"` — if empty, your kernel lacks `CONFIG_OVERLAY_FS`
  • **Try switching mount method** in KernelSU Manager → Settings → try toggling between OverlayFS and Magic Mount
  • **Check KSU logs:** `su -c "cat /data/adb/ksud.log | tail -50"` — look for mount errors
  • Run the diagnostic: `su -c sh /data/adb/modules/Sound_And_Emoji_IOS/dump_logs.sh` and attach to your GitHub issue
  • Note: On KernelSU Next, seeing `verifiedbootstate=green` is normal behavior and NOT a canoe indicator; the module cleanly distinguishes standard KernelSU Next from canoe environments.

  • In V2.0.12+, the neutral yellow skin tone option has been completely restored via OpenType Format 14 CMAP (UVS).

  • Emojis with two people or hands (e.g. handshake 🤝, couples 👯) use Gboard's native 2-step selection matrix.
  • The grey figures are **visual placeholders** waiting for your selection:

    • - Row 1: Selects the tone for the left figure (right figure is grey/placeholder).

  • To select the default yellow combination for both, simply tap the dual-yellow emoji in the bottom row.

  • In V2.0.13, the module's boot cleaner and installer have been completely overhauled to protect on-device speech models (`superpacks/speech` and `ondevice_recognizer`).
